## EMST role: Environmental compliance inspector (state variant, entry level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.55, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R12-environmental-compliance-inspector/state:2651`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — entry L1
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — entry L1
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — entry L1
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — entry L1
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — entry L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — entry L1
- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — entry L1
- Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release — entry L1
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — entry L1
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — entry L1
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — entry L1
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1
- Communicate technical environmental information in writing and speech — entry L1

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Plan a compliance inspection from the facility's permit, compliance history and monitoring reports, listing the conditions to verify and the evidence to collect
- Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence
- Collect samples and photographs during an inspection under chain-of-custody procedures, so that the evidence is admissible in an enforcement proceeding
- Write an inspection report stating findings of fact for each condition inspected, separating the inspector's observations from conclusions
- Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
- Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
- Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them
- Verify a facility's self-reported emissions or discharge values against independent remote-sensing or ambient data, stating the discrepancy and its uncertainty
- Audit an environmental dataset on a set schedule, identifying errors and anomalies and recording each correction with its basis.
- Answer compliance questions from regulated entities through a help line or portal, recording each question and the guidance given for consistency review
- Identify signs of potential hazardous materials at a field site, such as drums, stained soil, odours or unusual debris, before disturbing them
- Follow a site health and safety plan at a contaminated or industrial site, observing zone boundaries, air-monitoring action levels and decontamination steps

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* 2 not shown until the issuer is verified
